hypothesis: Request221's pullback opportunity signal failed as Request222's fixed three-event WAIT action because the correct redecision time is state-dependent. Re-evaluating WAIT versus EXIT at every observed pullback state should preserve opportunity while cutting deteriorating pullbacks earlier.
frozen: semantic WAIT boundary at predicted continuation value > 0
pullback_context: BASE return change since pullback onset
worst BASE return change reached so far
recovery from that causal worst point

target.name: adaptive_wait_value_pct
target.definition: At every observed state inside a pullback, value at the first future causal reacceleration decision point, or first observed 30-minute cap state if no reacceleration occurs, minus EXIT-now.

policy.rule: WAIT while predicted adaptive_wait_value_pct > 0. Re-evaluate at every observed pullback state. EXIT on the first nonpositive score. If reacceleration arrives first, hand control to the next controller.

candidates: current state plus causal pullback context
Request220 entry-conditioned state plus causal pullback context

comparators: exit immediately at pullback onset, whose local uplift is zero
forbidden: changing the reacceleration definition after seeing Request178 results
using future prices, future gaps, or future terminal timing as model input
tuning the zero WAIT boundary on Request178
calling a local pullback controller a validated full trading strategy
next_if_pass: Freeze the adaptive pullback node, connect the reacceleration handoff to a continuation/exit controller, and replay complete Request208-entry trajectories.
next_if_fail: Stop generic modeling across all pullbacks. Audit which causal pullback geometries carry the Request221 opportunity signal and restrict the controller to that event subset.
